title: deschampsia cespitosa subsp. littoralis
intro: Deschampsia cespitosa subsp. littoralis, commonly known as seaside bent or coastal hair grass, is a perennial grass species native to coastal areas of the Northern Hemisphere. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, making it a potential natural remedy for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Deschampsia cespitosa subsp. littoralis include anti-inflammatory and expectorant effects, which help to clear mucus from the lungs and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
